compute_f1_metric: compute F1 score between a predicted text and a list of answer strings using F1Metric.compute
compute_exact_match: compute exact match accuracy between a prediction and a list of answer strings using ExactMatchMetric.compute
compute_bleu_score: compute approximate BLEU score between a prediction and answer strings using BleuMetric.compute with n-gram order k
compute_rouge_scores: compute ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores between a prediction and answer strings using RougeMetric.compute_many
aggregate_metrics_reports: aggregate metrics from multiple named task reports into a single combined report using aggregate_named_reports
